events.title: market_briefing_prepare_kr
events.depends_on: verified KR raw marker for SNAP; confirmed K and frozen bundle; source export remains a separate prerequisite

events.title: market_briefing_prepare_us
events.trigger: daily 17:30 KST, after sdc_daily_us 15:00, sdc_daily_us_derive_daily 15:30 and sdc_daily_us_universe_incremental 16:30
events.depends_on: derive_daily and universe_incremental of the same day finished code 0; frozen release with financial_selection_rule det_a; hash-pinned score_equivalent evidence; reviewed US E table. Measured 2026-09-30 isolated: 2m06-2m09 wall, 4.4GB max RSS on 2 cores
events.stock_data_root: SERVING_STOCK_ROOT with us/raw and us/derived as read-only links to the US lake and us/output as a real directory; prepared_root/us links to SERVING_STOCK_ROOT/us/output/us_scoring_daily_v1/prepared
events.a_rule: A = E(run date + 1 calendar day) = last XNYS session closed at 15:00 KST of the run date; computed by the us_expected session command, never inferred from data

fixed_parity_evidence.note: copy into the frozen release area before activation; any modeler code or financial_code_hash change needs a new parity-check run and a new evidence sha

events.operational_selection_note: stays false in this proposal; the native manifest itself is serving_eligible=true, but us-expected-source reviewed_status is unreviewed until a person confirms the policy
events.skip_when: prepare for A already exists with the same prep_id (idempotent) or run date is not followed by a new session

events.title: market_briefing_us_expected_refresh
events.trigger: monthly, day 1 at 08:30 KST, outside the 09:30-10:35 D window
events.depends_on: KR holiday CSV and NYSE calendar cover the new range (KR to 2026-12-31, NYSE to 2027-12-31); daily_inputs pins the table sha per D, so never replace the file while a D selection is open
events.procedure: write a new dated file (the command refuses to overwrite), review the diff against the previous file for overlapping dates (must be identical), then switch config us_expected_source to it; regenerate with --reviewed-status confirmed --review-note only after a person confirms the policy
events.current_example: 2026-10-01..2026-12-31 table built 2026-09-30 with reviewed_status=unreviewed (not in any config)

events.title: market_briefing_open_watch
events.depends_on: confirmed KR session calendar, KIS credentials, reviewed timed provider and sector specs, and live source observation time; captured slots are private
events.opening_build: modeler.serving.daily_wrapper run invokes modeler.serving.opening_prepare from D slots at the fixed 10:00 cutoff
